title: Spend more time writing
use_cases: Use when you need to sync drafts from Google Drive or local files
Implement when organizing complex characters, locations, and plot events
Configure when requiring a searchable compendium of existing story drafts
Use when you want to visualize story elements on a second screen while writing
Use when maintaining a living wiki that updates automatically with new writing
content:
Mythril helps you spend more time crafting great stories and less time needing to keep track of all your world’s details

1

#### Connect your work

Upload as little as a draft chapter or sync with Google Drive. We support all major formats including DOCX, PDF, and plain text.

2

#### Automatic analysis

Mythril analyzes your story and organizes characters, locations, objects, and plot events into a searchable compendium.

3

#### Explore your world

Mythril works as your second screen letting you find, recall and visualize the world you developed and the stories you have written.

4

#### Update on demand

Easily sync to your latest drafts with Mythril’s streamlined workflow, turning your compendium into a living wiki.
